mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS appointmentId, a.tenant_id AS appointmentTenantId, a.status AS appointmentStatus, h.id AS houseId, h.landlord_id AS houseLandlordId, h.title AS houseTitle, h.price AS housePrice, h.deposit AS houseDeposit, h.status AS houseStatus, hi.url AS houseCover FROM appointment a JOIN house h ON h.id = a.house_id LEFT JOIN house_image hi ON hi.house_id = h.id AND hi.is_cover = 1 WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId}

SELECT h.id AS houseId, h.title AS houseTitle, h.price AS housePrice, h.deposit AS houseDeposit, hi.url AS houseCover, l.name AS landlordName FROM house h LEFT JOIN house_image hi ON hi.house_id = h.id AND hi.is_cover = 1 LEFT JOIN landlord l ON l.id = h.landlord_id WHERE h.id IN #{hid}
SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.nickname AS tenantName FROM tenant t WHERE t.id IN #{tid}
SELECT phone FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId}
